sourceAnchors.visualArbitrationNote: Printed page 483 states that Integration coupled with a paroxysmal surprise mechanism is characteristic for Phobie and gives the Ich forms Sch=±± or Sch=±+. The page defines Integration testologically as drawing Randtrieb dangers/dilemmas into the Ich, shifting danger from the Rand toward the Ich.

Printed page 484 gives a compact summary for Phobie: Unitendenz des Gutmachen-Wollens P=+0 coupled with Integration in the Ich, Sch=±± or ±+. This summary is retained as a source-specific coupling, while the preceding p. 483 text also discusses Affektflut/-ebbe and therefore the P component is not generalized beyond the source's own formulations.

sourceExcerpt: Die Integration, gekoppelt mit einem paroxysmalen Überraschungsmechanismus, ist für die Phobie charakteristisch: Sch = ± ± oder Sch = ± +.
romanianRendering: Pentru Phobie, Szondi pune în centru cuplarea unui mecanism paroxysmal cu Integration în Ich, formulată prin Sch=±± sau Sch=±+. În rezumatul de la p. 484, această structură este asociată cu P=+0, `Unitendenz des Gutmachen-Wollens`.
doctrinalStatement: În cadrul istoric al Paroxysmalneurosen, `Integration` cuplată cu un mecanism paroxysmal este descrisă ca structură caracteristică pentru `Phobie`; formele Ich exacte sunt `Sch = ±±` sau `Sch = ±+`. Szondi definește Integration ca mutarea dilemelor/pericolelor Rand în Ich. Rezumatul p. 484 adaugă `P = +0` ca `Unitendenz des Gutmachen-Wollens`, dar pasajul p. 483 discută și Affektflut/-ebbe; de aceea P=+0 este păstrat ca formulare de rezumat source-specific, nu transformat într-un unic trigger obligatoriu.
conditions: Requires the coupled paroxysmal + Integration context; Sch=±±/±+ must not be read in isolation.
Keep the p. 483 and p. 484 P-formulations together rather than forcing a single simplified P trigger.
exceptions: Do not infer Phobie from Sch=±± or Sch=±+ alone.
Do not require P=+0 as the only possible paroxysmal configuration given the source's adjacent Affektflut/-ebbe formulation.
Do not map the historical category directly onto contemporary phobic disorders.
scopeNotes: The testological definition of Integration is retained because it links Rand-Mitte structure to the specific source pairing.
No detailed phobia symptom examples are serialized.

relations.note: Specifies the source-defined paroxysmal + Integration pairing for Phobie.

ambiguities: The source gives both an Affektflut/-ebbe description on p. 483 and a P=+0 summary on p. 484; these are retained as adjacent formulations rather than silently collapsed.
reviewNotes: Canonical BODY U005588-U005592 and U005633-U005635 checked against deterministic P0 evidence; admitted PDF printed pages 483-484 visually arbitrated.
P2A only; no automatic phobia classifier is added.
